name: sno-station-standalone
description: Twelve Sno Station skills for review, intent checks, end-to-end triage, work briefs, Shell, TypeScript, Python and Rust coding, and test writing that run without Sno Station programs or hooks.

interface.longDescription: Twelve skills that work on their own, with no Sno Station programs, no hooks and no account. less-is-more writes the least code that works and cuts what an agent over-built. owner-intent-audit checks plans, tests or code against what the owner actually asked for. agentic-walkthrough proves that a reported run caused its real effect. first-principles-review challenges a product idea or design before it becomes code. e2e-environment-preflight and e2e-red-triage check an end-to-end run's environment and sort a failure into product defect or environment fault. charter writes the brief that tells an executor what to deliver. shellscript-coder, ts-coder, python-coder and rust-coder write production code that fits the repository, and test-writer writes tests that can fail when the code is wrong. Nothing in this plugin sends data anywhere, calls a remote service, or installs packages.
defaultPrompt: Cut what is over-built in my current diff
Check this plan against what I actually asked for
Write tests for the code I just changed
